    About this platform

    Prepared by Dr. Saghir Ahmad — psychologist, educationist and author — to spread simple, honest health awareness in English and Urdu for families across Pakistan.

    Important: This platform is for health education only. It is not medical advice and does not replace a doctor. If you are unwell, please see a qualified doctor or visit your nearest hospital.
